title: In-place Restore kind: flow dir: down
req: Restore | inPlace members @gray
[Restore] blue export: Export | Backup <name>-before check: Checks pass? | every part and member hold: Hold the namespace | stop engines, workers load: Loaded? | each member, in order [/]
done: Succeeded | the hold lifted @green f2: Failed during the load | the hold stays @red f1: Failed before the hold | nothing written @red
req > export > check check > hold: yes check > f1: no hold > load load > done: yes load > f2: no
